platform-copilot.purpose: Answer questions about this LLMOps platform itself — how it works, why it was designed that way, how to operate it and how it is doing right now — using the platform documentation and its live metrics. It must not answer questions unrelated to the platform, and must not reveal secrets or personal data.

judge.purpose: Grade the runs of other agents against their purpose. Internal agent of the platform; it calls no tools.
